subject: E-Commerce
title: The Race to the Bottom on Price
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Race to the Bottom on Price usable.

hook.text: Amazon's algorithm rewards the cheapest offer. Sellers undercut each other until margins reach zero—then negative.

buildup.text: Identical products from multiple sellers create price wars. Algorithms automatically lower prices to win the Buy Box.

discovery.text: Repricing bots adjust prices every 15 minutes. If a competitor drops by $0.01, your bot matches instantly.

twist.text: Some sellers sell below cost to gain reviews and rankings, planning to raise prices later. Many never recover the loss.

climax.text: Marketplace algorithms optimize for lowest consumer price but destroy seller profitability in the process.

punchline.text: Reprice every 15 minutes, margins hit zero. Algorithms serve buyers only.

quiz.question: What do repricing bots do on Amazon?
options: Automatically adjust prices to match or beat competitors, often every 15 minutes
